narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Sixty is small enough. I will write sixty in the ones place.
<bookmark mark='group'/>Sixty ones make one full sixty, the way sixty minutes make one hour.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The ones place can never hold sixty, so his numeral cannot be right.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows 60 written in the ones place; sixty ones slide together into one group of sixty; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='back'/>To check, multiply each count by the value of its place, then add them up.
<bookmark mark='cap'/>Then make sure no place holds sixty or more, and that empty places are blank.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer card; two check lines appear: multiply each place by its value and add; no place holds sixty or more

old_misconception.wrong_answer: write sixty in the ones place
old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu wants to write sixty in the ones place. Sixty ones make one sixty, so sixty is one in the sixties place with the ones place empty.
